entry_execution: five-minute post-only LIMIT at the frozen pre-session boundary with contingent TP/SL

development_week.use: session-state development only; not counted as a fresh random-week pass

causal_question: At repeated session activity transitions, did aggressive flow merely collect external pre-session liquidity and fail because the front book replenished, or did it create accepted price discovery because the front book was withdrawn?

mutually_exclusive_session_states.setup: directional aggressive flow sweeps one frozen pre-session boundary, same-side one-percent depth rebuilds, price impact is inefficient and the completed minute closes back inside
mutually_exclusive_session_states.entry: post-only limit at the consumed boundary
mutually_exclusive_session_states.invalidation: beyond the observed sweep extreme plus 0.10 ATR

mutually_exclusive_session_states.setup: directional aggressive flow closes beyond one frozen pre-session boundary, same-side one-percent depth is withdrawn, opposite depth is stable and price impact is efficient
mutually_exclusive_session_states.confirmation: second consecutive completed minute closes outside the same boundary
mutually_exclusive_session_states.entry: post-only limit at the accepted boundary

family_promotion_rule: The central 30-minute pre-session range and at least one adjacent 20- or 45-minute range must satisfy every gate. Only then is the unchanged 30-minute classifier locked before a newly selected uncollected first BTC week.
fresh_data_rule: No fresh random-week direct data is collected before the revealed-week horizon plateau passes.
